app.title: H0melab Downloader
app.subtitle: Self-hosted — for your Plex Media Server

add.heading: Add a new download
add.languageHint: Pick the language the video will be downloaded in. The UI language (top right) is independent.
add.languageLockedHint: Megakino only hosts German movies — language picker is disabled.
add.watchSeasonHint: Puts this season on a watchlist. When a new episode becomes available in the selected language, it's automatically added to the queue.
add.noEpisodesInLang: No episodes available in this language
add.seasonPartial: {{added}} of {{total}} episodes added. {{skipped}} episodes are not yet available in {{language}}. Add the season to the watchlist so missing episodes are downloaded automatically when they become available?
add.seasonNoneAvailable: None of the {{total}} episodes are currently available in {{language}}. Add the season to the watchlist so they are downloaded automatically when they become available?
add.episodeNotInLang: {{episode}} is not currently available in {{language}}. Add the season to the watchlist so it's downloaded automatically when it becomes available?

queue.heading: Download queue
queue.pauseAllHint: Pauses every running and queued download
queue.stopAllHint: Aborts every running download immediately and marks them as paused

watchlist.heading: Season watchlist
watchlist.explanation: The watchlist periodically checks whether new episodes of a season are available in your chosen language. When they are, they're automatically added to the download queue.
watchlist.emptyHint: Go to Add → search a series → pick a season → then click "Auto-download new episodes".
watchlist.intervalNote: Checked periodically. Change the interval under Settings → Scheduler → Check interval.

upcoming.heading: Upcoming watchlist
upcoming.emptyWatchlist: No upcoming items. Search TMDB below for a title you want to watch for.
upcoming.needsTmdbKey: A TMDB API key is required for the upcoming tab.
upcoming.needsTmdbKeyHint: Grab a free key at themoviedb.org/signup, then paste it under Settings → API keys.
upcoming.searchPlaceholder: Leave empty to show TMDB's upcoming list
upcoming.intervalNote: Checked periodically. Change the interval under Settings → Scheduler → Check interval.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.hosterHint: Comma-separated, first hoster is tried first
settings.releaseCheckHint: How often the scheduler probes source sites for new episodes (Watchlist) and released titles (Upcoming). Minimum 5, maximum 1440. Changes apply on the next tick — no restart required.
settings.schedulerExplanation: Drives the Watchlist and Upcoming tabs. Lower value = faster reaction to new episodes, but more traffic to source sites. Recommended: 30–120.
settings.leaveBlank: Leave blank to keep current value
